sources.title: Riscos de Momostenango: sacred-site visitor information
sources.authority: Consejo Nacional de Áreas Protegidas, Guatemala
sources.supports: Read directly: Totonicapán location and use by some local Indigenous people for ancestral ceremonies; no community visitor-consent process stated.

culture-and-protocol.sacred_or_restricted_places: Riscos de Momostenango: the official visitor guide identifies ceremonial use by some local Indigenous residents. Its access listing is not permission to enter a ceremony or photograph/record participants.
culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: Ceremonial community authority not yet checked. CONAP publishes this park guide but is not assumed to be the ceremonial authority.
culture-and-protocol.note: Site-specific sacred-place baseline only; the community's own consent procedures and wider Totonicapán protocols not yet checked.
